crossRefs.note: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother…
If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.kjv: And Abraham said, I will swear.
translations.asv: And Abraham said, I will swear.
